en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a small market square lined with multi‑storey shop buildings, with large painted advertisements on the façades. On the left, several stores bear the name "Oscar Reich" and other commercial signage. In the middle distance is a tall gabled Gothic-style hall-like building with a stepped façade and many small windows. To the right are older, fortress‑like houses and a small square with cobblestones. At the top in red print is the caption "Meissen. Kleinmarkt."
